title: Benchmarking Factual Robustness of LLMs via Multi-conversation Persuasion
abstract: arXiv:2609.16777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as primary knowledge retrieval interfaces, their robustness against \textit{persuasion attacks}---attempts to inject misinformation or enforce counterfactuals---has become a critical safety concern. Existing red-teaming frameworks typically evaluate models in multi-turn dialogues where the target model retains full conversation history. We identify a critical flaw in this setting termed \textbf{``Refusal Inertia''}: a model's initial refusal often propagates through subsequent turns largely to maintain contextual consistency, thereby masking its true vulnerability to sophisticated, isolated persuasion attempts. To rigorously evaluate the ``cold-start'' defense capabilities of SOTA models, we introduce the \textbf{SAST-IR} (Stateful Attacker, Stateless Target - Iterative Refinement) framework. translated_title: 通过多对话说服对大语言模型事实稳健性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）日益成为主要的知识检索接口，其对抗“说服攻击”——即注入错误信息或强制反事实的尝试——的稳健性已成为一个关键的安全问题。现有的红队测试框架通常在目标模型保留完整对话历史的多轮对话中评估模型。我们在这一设置中发现了一个关键缺陷，称为**“拒绝惯性”**：模型的初始拒绝往往会为了保持上下文一致性而在后续轮次中延续，从而掩盖了其对复杂的、孤立的说服尝试的真实脆弱性。为了严格评估最先进模型的“冷启动”防御能力，我们引入了**SAST-IR**（有状态攻击者、无状态目标-迭代优化）框架。通过对目标模型强制执行记忆清除，同时保留攻击者的对话历史，我们模拟了一种……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了多轮对话安全评估中“拒绝惯性”这一关键缺陷——模型的初始拒绝仅为维持上下文一致性而延续，并提出SAST-IR框架（保留攻击者历史、清除目标模型记忆）来严格评估大语言模型在孤立说服攻击下的真实防御能力。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "Refusal Inertia," a critical flaw in multi-turn dialogue evaluations where a model's initial refusal propagates merely for contextual consistency, and proposes the SAST-IR framework (Stateful Attacker, Stateless Target - Iterative Refinement) to rigorously assess LLMs' true vulnerability to isolated persuasion attacks by enforcing memory wipes on the target model.
